name: OpenWebWeaver
tagline: Interact with WebWeaver based online learning platforms
blurb: OpenWebWeaver allows you to interact with WebWeaver based online leaning platforms.
description:
OpenWebWeaver allows you to interact with WebWeaver based online leaning platforms. Credentials provided by your institution are required in order to use this app.

Tasks
Read, edit and create tasks

Board notifications
Read, edit and create board notifications

Contacts
Read, edit and create contacts

Notes
Read, edit and create notes

Messenger
Send and receive messages

Mail service
Send and receive emails

File storage
Upload and download files from file storage

System notifications
View system notifications

Forum
Read forum posts and comments
